_comment: P3-M07 taught short-descriptor fixture. Deterministic teaching fixture, NOT live kernel state.

assumptions.note: TEX[2:1] ignored by HW under TRE=1. S=0 on Normal memory is still Normal (UP policy); validators must NOT hard-require S=1.

entries.AP_meaning: PL1-only (PL1 RW, PL0 none) under AFE=0 Table B3-8
entries.rationale: Section, AP=001 PL1-only, n=111 Normal WBWA Inner-Shareable, XN=0 executable, nG=0 global.

entries.AP_meaning: PL1-only (PL1 RW, PL0 none) under AFE=0 Table B3-8
entries.rationale: Small page (0b1x), bit0 IS the XN bit (0b11 XN=1), AP=001 PL1-only, n=100 Shareable Device, XN=1.

L1 0b11 is PXN-section-or-reserved; the frozen Linux never emits it. A decoder must REJECT it as not-a-taught-mapping (malformed for this fixture's taught classes). Malformed/tool errors are ERROR only when the tool itself fails; a clean semantic reject of this entry is the intended REJECT verdict.
